```sql
alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

create policy "classes_select_authenticated"
  on public.classes for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

create policy "class_spots_select_authenticated"
  on public.class_spots for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_insert_member"
  on public.class_spots for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and (
          (status = 'enrolled'
           and (
             select count(*)
             from public.class_spots s
             where s.class_id = c.id
               and s.status = 'enrolled'
           ) < c.capacity
          )
          or (status = 'waitlisted'
             and (
               select count(*)
               from public.class_spots s
               where s.class_id = c.id
                 and s.status = 'enrolled'
             ) >= c.capacity
           )
        )
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_update_waitlist_move"
  on public.class_spots for update
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'enrolled'
    and old.status = 'waitlisted'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_id
        and (
          select count(*)
          from public.class_spots s
          where s.class_id = c.id
            and s.status = 'enrolled'
        ) < c.capacity
    )
  );

create policy "class_spots_delete_member"
  on public.class_spots for delete
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

create policy "class_spots_instructor_delete"
  on public.class_spots for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );
```
